[Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

  Business Solutions
  
  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## Salesforce CRM FAQs

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][86] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring
companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic
AI][87] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and
IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][88] and [what Salesforce does][89] by
visiting [our official resources][90]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads,
close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic
platform.

### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it?

[**CRM**][91] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all
your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system
helps you:

**• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data
**• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails**
• Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you
a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][92], allowing you to build stronger, more
profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

[**Agentic AI**][93] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act
[**autonomously**][94] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike
traditional [AI][95] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan
multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][96] technology — is used to:

**• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
**• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
**• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and
small businesses][97] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and
scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or
marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for
what you use and have an[ AI and CRM][98] platform that can grow with your business.

[Salesforce Starter][99] helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of
sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup
process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of
mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

## Salesforce CRM FAQs

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][86] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring
companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic
AI][87] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and
IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][88] and [what Salesforce does][89] by
visiting [our official resources][90]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads,
close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic
platform.

### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it?

[**CRM**][91] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all
your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system
helps you:

**• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data
**• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails**
• Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you
a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][92], allowing you to build stronger, more
profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

[**Agentic AI**][93] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act
[**autonomously**][94] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike
traditional [AI][95] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan
multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][96] technology — is used to:

**• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
**• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
**• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and
small businesses][97] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and
scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or
marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for
what you use and have an[ AI and CRM][98] platform that can grow with your business.

[Salesforce Starter][99] helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of
sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup
process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of
mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

## We screen 200+ candidates weekly and accept fewer than 5%. Here's what makes our vetting
## different from every other offshore staffing company.

#### No more revolving door hires.

Our **Anti-Job Hopper Filter** screens out anyone with a history of jumping from job to job every
few months. Every candidate we send you has a track record of staying put and actually growing with
a company, not just using it as a pit stop.

#### You'll actually be able to understand them.

We use what we call the **One-Repeat Rule**. If our recruiters have to ask a candidate to repeat
themselves more than once during the interview, they’re out. Period. Your clients, customers, and
team deserve someone who communicates clearly and confidently every time.

#### They can't fake their way through our tests.

Our **AI-Proof Assessment** is built so candidates have to show real, hands-on experience, not just
copy-paste a ChatGPT answer. We make them prove they know their stuff before they ever get in front
of you.

#### We narrow it down so you don't have to.

After all that vetting, we hand you 3 to 4 of the best candidates to choose from. No sifting through
a pile of resumes, just a few solid people who’ve already passed the hard part.

#### Billing is simple, and the paperwork isn't your problem.

Once you hire, you’ll get a monthly Stripe invoice, that’s it. All the compliance, contracts, and
back-end paperwork are handled by Ataraxis so you can stay focused on running your business.

**Read more about our vetting process: [Why Most Global Hiring Fails, And How the Ataraxis Vetting
Process Fixes It][141]**

## How Much Does a Virtual Assistant Cost?

Offshore staffing through Ataraxis costs a fraction of what a comparable U.S. hire runs once you
factor in salary, benefits, payroll tax, and recruiting overhead. There are no upfront fees, no
lock-in contracts, and no billing surprises. The numbers below show exactly what you pay and what
you save.

##### $1,950

### Full-time / month

174 hrs · $11/hr all-in

##### $1,100

### Part-time / month

87 hrs · $12/hr all-in

##### $23,400

### Annual cost, full-time

vs. $60–97k for a U.S. hire

##### 1–2 wks

### Time to hire

2–3 vetted candidates

A skilled professional who provides remote support to your business. Hiring a Virtual Assistant lets
you outsource everyday tasks, giving you and your employees more time and freedom to focus on
growing your business.

##### Property Management Virtual Assistant

A specialized remote professional equipped to support your real estate operations by handling
administrative and tenant-facing duties.

## 03

##### Virtual Assistant for Mental Health Practices

Trained to support therapists, psychologists, psychiatrists, and counseling clinics with both
administrative and clinical workflows. They assist with charting, intake coordination, scheduling,
patient communication, and EHR updates.

[ Learn More ][145]

## 04

##### Virtual Medical Receptionist

Manages front-desk responsibilities for healthcare practices. They handle patient communication,
appointment scheduling, and administrative tasks to ensure smooth day-to-day operations while
reducing in-office workload.

[ Learn More ][146]

## 05

##### Virtual Medical Assistant

Helps streamline clinical and administrative workflows. They assist providers with charting,
scheduling, patient communication, and other essential tasks.

## 06

##### Bookkeeper

Ensures your business’s financial records are accurate and up to date. They manage day-to-day
financial tasks, enabling you to make informed decisions and maintain compliance.

## We screen 200+ candidates weekly and accept fewer than 5%. Here's what makes our vetting
## different from every other offshore staffing company.

#### No more revolving door hires.

Our **Anti-Job Hopper Filter** screens out anyone with a history of jumping from job to job every
few months. Every candidate we send you has a track record of staying put and actually growing with
a company, not just using it as a pit stop.

#### You'll actually be able to understand them.

We use what we call the **One-Repeat Rule**. If our recruiters have to ask a candidate to repeat
themselves more than once during the interview, they’re out. Period. Your clients, customers, and
team deserve someone who communicates clearly and confidently every time.

#### They can't fake their way through our tests.

Our **AI-Proof Assessment** is built so candidates have to show real, hands-on experience, not just
copy-paste a ChatGPT answer. We make them prove they know their stuff before they ever get in front
of you.

#### We narrow it down so you don't have to.

After all that vetting, we hand you 3 to 4 of the best candidates to choose from. No sifting through
a pile of resumes, just a few solid people who’ve already passed the hard part.

#### Billing is simple, and the paperwork isn't your problem.

Once you hire, you’ll get a monthly Stripe invoice, that’s it. All the compliance, contracts, and
back-end paperwork are handled by Ataraxis so you can stay focused on running your business.

**Read more about our vetting process: [Why Most Global Hiring Fails, And How the Ataraxis Vetting
Process Fixes It][141]**

lock-in contracts, and no billing surprises. The numbers below show exactly what you pay and what

## Common questions

What if the hire does not work out?

24-month free replacement guarantee. If a hire made through your membership does not work out at any
point in the first 24 months, we replace them at no additional cost. Same vetting standards. Same
speed. No questions asked. This is the strongest guarantee in the market.

How fast can I hire?

You will receive matched, verified candidate profiles within 48 hours of posting your role. Most
companies complete interviews within the first week and have a new hire onboarded within 2-3 weeks.

Can I see candidates before committing?

Yes. You can browse candidate profiles publicly: photos, cover videos, role titles, countries,
software tags, and monthly rate ranges are all visible without an account. To see exact all-in rates
and book interviews, create a free account. To receive a curated shortlist, activate your $299/month
membership. You only pay the all-in monthly rate when you hire.

Do I need to handle payroll and compliance?

No. CloudTask handles all payroll, benefits, taxes, and labor law compliance across 12 LATAM
countries. We act as the employer of record so you can focus on managing your team, not paperwork.

What does it cost?

$299/month hiring membership. No contract. Cancel anytime. When you find a candidate you want to
hire, the monthly rate on their profile is the all-in price. That includes everything: compensation,
managed marketplace services, compliance, and protection. No hidden fees. No surprise charges. What
you see is what you pay.

What tools do candidates know?

Candidates are tested and certified across 25,000+ SaaS and AI tools including Salesforce, HubSpot,
Gong, Outreach, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Gainsight, Zendesk, and many more. Tool proficiency is verified

## Common questions

What if the hire does not work out?

24-month free replacement guarantee. If a hire made through your membership does not work out at any
point in the first 24 months, we replace them at no additional cost. Same vetting standards. Same
speed. No questions asked. This is the strongest guarantee in the market.

How fast can I hire?

You will receive matched, verified candidate profiles within 48 hours of posting your role. Most
companies complete interviews within the first week and have a new hire onboarded within 2-3 weeks.

Can I see candidates before committing?

Yes. You can browse candidate profiles publicly: photos, cover videos, role titles, countries,
software tags, and monthly rate ranges are all visible without an account. To see exact all-in rates
and book interviews, create a free account. To receive a curated shortlist, activate your $299/month
membership. You only pay the all-in monthly rate when you hire.

Do I need to handle payroll and compliance?

No. CloudTask handles all payroll, benefits, taxes, and labor law compliance across 12 LATAM
countries. We act as the employer of record so you can focus on managing your team, not paperwork.

What does it cost?

$299/month hiring membership. No contract. Cancel anytime. When you find a candidate you want to
hire, the monthly rate on their profile is the all-in price. That includes everything: compensation,
managed marketplace services, compliance, and protection. No hidden fees. No surprise charges. What
you see is what you pay.

Candidates are tested and certified across 25,000+ SaaS and AI tools including Salesforce, HubSpot,

## Finding healthcare partners shouldn't feel like gambling

Healthcare organizations spend countless hours evaluating vendors, only to discover compliance gaps
after contracts are signed. Generic directories don't understand HIPAA, SOC 2, or BAAs.

**Curatrix is different.** We manually vet every provider against healthcare-specific criteria
before they're listed. No self-serve signups. No pay-to-play rankings. Just verified,
healthcare-ready partners.

## Built for Healthcare Decision-Makers

Whether you're evaluating compliance consultants or development partners, Curatrix reduces your
vendor risk.

### Health Systems & Hospitals

Find pre-vetted vendors for IT, compliance, and operational needs without the usual procurement
guesswork.

### Digital Health Companies

Scale faster with partners who already understand healthcare regulations and workflows.

### Payers & Health Plans

Reduce vendor risk with providers proven to meet enterprise healthcare standards.

## How Our Vetting Works

100% manual review. No self-serve listings. Every provider earns their place.

01

### Eligibility Screening

Every provider must pass our 7-point eligibility gate. We verify US healthcare market presence,
active business status, and legitimate healthcare clients.

02

### Deep Evaluation

Qualified providers are scored across 120+ data points covering healthcare experience,
certifications, compliance readiness, and client portfolio.

03

### Tier Assignment

Scores determine tier placement: Premier, Elite, Select, or Emerging. Tiers are earned through
merit—never purchased.

#### Patient Calls & Phone Management

#### What Your VA Handles

Answering inbound calls, triaging patient questions, routing urgent matters, taking messages, and
helping manage high call volume during busy clinic hours.

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Understands clinical context well enough to separate routine questions from situations that need
immediate staff attention, reducing interruptions for your clinical team while keeping patients
supported.

#### Appointment Scheduling & Management

#### What Your VA Handles

Booking, rescheduling, confirmations,
cancellation management, waitlist coordination

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Knows how different appointment types affect your day: a new patient consult isn’t the same as a
follow-up, and scheduling errors have downstream effects your VA knows how to anticipate

#### Insurance Verification & Prior Authorization

#### What Your VA Handles

Verifying insurance eligibility, checking benefits, collecting required documentation, submitting
prior authorization requests, and following up with payers for status updates.

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Knows how healthcare workflows, payer requirements, and authorization timelines affect patient care,
helping reduce appointment delays, claim issues, and unnecessary back-and-forth for your in-office
team.

#### Medical Records & Chart Prep

#### What Your VA Handles

Preparing patient charts, organizing medical records, updating patient information, attaching
relevant documents, and making sure providers have the right details before each appointment.

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Understands what clinical teams need before a visit, helping reduce missing information, rushed prep
work, and provider downtime caused by incomplete charts.

#### Billing & Administrative Support

#### What Your VA Handles

Supporting billing workflows, preparing patient statements, following up on balances, updating
administrative records, handling routine billing questions, and coordinating with internal billing
teams.

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Combines administrative accuracy with healthcare-specific knowledge, helping your practice keep
operations organized without pulling clinical staff into repetitive billing and paperwork tasks.

#### Live Medical Scribing

#### What Your VA Handles

Documenting patient encounters in real time, capturing provider notes, updating visit summaries,
organizing clinical details, and helping reduce after-hours documentation work.

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Understands medical terminology and visit flow, allowing providers to stay focused on the patient
instead of splitting attention between care delivery and charting.

#### Patient Follow-Up & Communication

#### What Your VA Handles

Following up with patients after appointments, sending reminders, coordinating next steps, helping
schedule recommended visits, and communicating routine care instructions approved by your team.

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Keeps patient communication consistent and timely while understanding when a message should be
escalated to clinical staff, improving continuity of care without adding pressure to your front
desk.

Need a role that spans several of these, or something specific to your specialty or workflow?

Patient Follow-Up & Communication

#### Patient Calls & Phone Management

#### What Your VA Handles

Answering inbound calls, triaging patient questions, routing urgent matters, taking messages, and
helping manage high call volume during busy clinic hours.

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Understands clinical context well enough to separate routine questions from situations that need
immediate staff attention, reducing interruptions for your clinical team while keeping patients
supported.

#### Appointment Scheduling & Management

#### What Your VA Handles

Booking, rescheduling, confirmations,
cancellation management, waitlist coordination

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Knows how different appointment types affect your day: a new patient consult isn’t the same as a
follow-up, and scheduling errors have downstream effects your VA knows how to anticipate

#### Insurance Verification & Prior Authorization

#### What Your VA Handles

Verifying insurance eligibility, checking benefits, collecting required documentation, submitting
prior authorization requests, and following up with payers for status updates.

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Knows how healthcare workflows, payer requirements, and authorization timelines affect patient care,
helping reduce appointment delays, claim issues, and unnecessary back-and-forth for your in-office
team.

#### Medical Records & Chart Prep

#### What Your VA Handles

Preparing patient charts, organizing medical records, updating patient information, attaching
relevant documents, and making sure providers have the right details before each appointment.

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Understands what clinical teams need before a visit, helping reduce missing information, rushed prep
work, and provider downtime caused by incomplete charts.

#### Billing & Administrative Support

#### What Your VA Handles

Supporting billing workflows, preparing patient statements, following up on balances, updating
administrative records, handling routine billing questions, and coordinating with internal billing
teams.

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Combines administrative accuracy with healthcare-specific knowledge, helping your practice keep
operations organized without pulling clinical staff into repetitive billing and paperwork tasks.

#### Live Medical Scribing

#### What Your VA Handles

Documenting patient encounters in real time, capturing provider notes, updating visit summaries,
organizing clinical details, and helping reduce after-hours documentation work.

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Understands medical terminology and visit flow, allowing providers to stay focused on the patient
instead of splitting attention between care delivery and charting.

#### Patient Follow-Up & Communication

#### What Your VA Handles

Following up with patients after appointments, sending reminders, coordinating next steps, helping
schedule recommended visits, and communicating routine care instructions approved by your team.

#### Why It's Better With a DocVA Specialist

Keeps patient communication consistent and timely while understanding when a message should be
escalated to clinical staff, improving continuity of care without adding pressure to your front
desk.

Need a role that spans several of these, or something specific to your specialty or workflow?
**We’ll** **build it with you.**

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

## FANUC and Google: Advancing Manufacturing Intelligence

FANUC is collaborating with Google to bring cloud-native artificial intelligence capabilities to
manufacturing plants, enabling smarter automation and predictive analytics across all production
environments.

## CRX-10*i*A/L Paint

The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the perfect industrial solution for manufacturers new to robotics.
This product line includes the CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot, which precisely dispenses materials for
uniform and reliable application in the paint, liquid and powder coatings, and fiberglass
industries. The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the first and only cobot certified for painting in
accordance with U.S. safety standards and is the best option on the market for precision dispensing
applications.

[ CRX-10iA/L Paint ][134]

## FANUC Accelerates Physical AI in Industrial Robotics, Leveraging NVIDIA Technologies

FANUC is combining its global leadership in robotics with NVIDIA’s AI computing and simulation
platforms to deliver intelligent and adaptable automation. This collaboration integrates ROBOGUIDE
with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse to create photorealistic digital twins, and enables robots to
interpret voice commands and automatically generate code.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is a medical virtual assistant?

Similar to an onsite medical assistant, a Medical Virtual Assistant works remotely handling clinical
and administrative tasks for healthcare practitioners.

What tasks do your MVAs perform?

Our MVAs are trained in EMR management, medical billing/coding, eligibility and benefit
verifications, answering the phones, processing prior authorization requests, and other tasks
specific to your practice.

Do you and your MVAs comply with HIPAA policies?

Yes. We conduct HIPAA training for all MVAs.

Where are the MVAs located?

Our Medical Virtual Assistants are located in the Philippines, India, and Central and South America.

How do I communicate with my MVA?

Our Medical Virtual Assistants are available through these communications methods: email, chat,
video conferencing, and by phone.

Do you offer dedicated MVAs?

Yes, all our MVAs are dedicated to just one practice/account alone.

Will GoLean sign a BAA?

Yes, GoLean will sign a BAA for you as an addition to our standard virtual assistant service.

How do I get started?

Click on the Find Your VA button, fill out the form, and we’ll contact you to discuss your needs and
the solutions we can offer for your practice. We’ll explain the process of integrating a Medical
Virtual Assistant for a smooth transition and onboarding.

Can I cancel any time?

Absolutely. This is a month-to-month commitment so you can cancel anytime – no questions asked.

What is a medical virtual assistant?

Similar to an onsite medical assistant, a Medical Virtual Assistant works remotely handling clinical
and administrative tasks for healthcare practitioners.

What tasks do your MVAs perform?

Our MVAs are trained in EMR management, medical billing/coding, eligibility and benefit
verifications, answering the phones, processing prior authorization requests, and other tasks
specific to your practice.

Our Medical Virtual Assistants are located in the Philippines, India, and Central and South America.

## The Original Healthcare Virtual Assistant® Company

[Schedule a Call][81]

## Hire a Healthcare Virtual Assistant Professional for $9.50/Hour

We provide dedicated, HIPAA-compliant Medical and [Healthcare Virtual Assistant][82] Professionals
to medical, dental, optometry, and veterinary practices. Our virtual assistants handle EMR
documentation, medical scribing, and back-office administrative tasks—so you can streamline
operations, increase revenue, and leave the office on time.

[Find Your Healthcare VA][83]

## Healthcare Professionals

Work with licensed nurses and healthcare professionals in the Philippines trained and vetted as
dedicated [Virtual Medical Assistant Professionals][84] supporting medical and specialty practices.

[Schedule a Call][85]

## [Flat-Rate Pricing $9.50/Hour][86]

Flat-rate pricing at $9.50 per hour. No long-term contracts. No setup fees. Flexible staffing
designed for growing medical and specialty practices.

## Selective Screening & Healthcare Training

We are highly selective about who we bring on. Every [Healthcare Virtual Assistant][87] Professional
goes through a multi-step screening process, skills testing, and hands-on HIPAA training before
working with any practice.

## [HIPAA Compliant Virtual Assistants][88]

All Healthcare Virtual Assistant Professionals complete HIPAA training and follow strict privacy and
security protocols to protect your patients, data, and practice.

## Dedicated Virtual Assistant — Not a Rotating Team

Our clients work with the same [Virtual Healthcare Assistant][89] every day, so there's consistency
and room for a genuine long-term working relationship — not a revolving door of new hires.

## Virtual Assistant Services for Modern Medical Practices

From real-time medical documentation to front-desk coordination and back-office support, our [HIPAA
compliant virtual assistants][90] integrate seamlessly into your practice. Our full range of
[Virtual Medical Assistant Services][91] is built so your team can focus on patient care, not
paperwork.

[

Real-time medical documentation, charting, and EMR support from a trained Healthcare Virtual
Assistant Professional who works directly within your existing workflows.

## Built by a Doctor.

Hello Rache was founded in 2017 by Dr. Mark Carnett, D.O. a practicing family physician who
experienced firsthand the burnout caused by EMR documentation and administrative overload.

After years of staying late to finish charts and manage back-office tasks, Dr. Carnett set out to
build a better solution, one designed specifically for medical practices, staffed by real people

That's when Hello Rache was born. Dr. Carnett has been using his own Healthcare Virtual Assistant
Services in his practice in Arizona for years now. It has saved him lots of stress, money, and -
most importantly, time.

At LatinoPro, we specialize in sourcing elite remote professionals for any position within your

in marketing, finance, and tech, we provide tailored recruitment solutions that seamlessly integrate

### Legal Services

LatinoPro HISTORY

## LatinoPro Was Born Out of a Desire to Redefine Remote Work

We recognized the extraordinary talent across Latin America, professionals with exceptional skills,
bilingual proficiency, and a strong work ethic. At the same time, we saw US businesses struggling to
find affordable, high-quality remote talent that truly fit their operational and cultural needs.
That gap is where we stepped in.

What began as a small team with a bold vision has grown into a trusted partner for businesses of all
sizes. We’ve helped startups, established companies, and scaling organizations grow efficiently by
connecting them with top-tier bilingual virtual assistants who are ready to make an immediate
impact. In doing so, we’ve also created meaningful opportunities for talented professionals to
thrive on a global stage

Specialising in placing highly skilled bilingual professionals from Latin America into U.S.

FOUNDER & CEO

## Revolutionizing the Virtual Assistant Landscape

Nathan Barz is the Visionary Founder CEO behind LatinoPro, a dynamic platform that connects talented
Hispanic professionals with top employers while also offering specialized virtual support services.
Under his leadership, LatinoPro has expanded to include roles such as virtual executive assistants,
virtual administrative assistants, social media virtual assistants, marketing virtual assistants,
and virtual appointment setters-ensuring that businesses have access to top-notch remote assistance.
His commitment to diversity and innovation continues to drive LatinoPro’s mission of empowering both
job seekers and employers in today’s digital landscape.

Nathan achieved Summa Cum Laude distinction at The Wharton School, highlighting his academic
excellence. Subsequently, he leveraged his skills to guide CEOs at Barclays Investment Bank through
strategic challenges. Afterwards, he founded DocVA: a platform designed to connect medical practices
with remote professionals. DocVA has placed more than 1000 VAs across North America. Nathan’s
success in his career speaks of his creativity, perception and adaptability in the virtual assistant
industry.

LatinoPro aims to empower businesses and elevate careers by offering innovative virtual support
services-from executive and administrative assistance to marketing and appointment setting.
LatinoPro is the ultimate hub connecting talented Hispanic professionals with top employers.

### Why work with Virtudesk

Virtudesk has a proven track record to provide services to its clients with utmost excellence. Our
commitment to our clients would be to give them more time to focus on what matters most to them.
That is, driving their company’s production and business growth to its optimal potential.

[Apply Now][2]

## System Requirements
* #### Windows
  * 2 Fully Functioning 64Bit Desktop/Laptop (1 for Backup)
  * Windows10/11 [64Bit Only]
  * Intel Core i3/i5/i7/i9 9th+ gen or higher (or AMD equivalent)
  * 8 GB RAM or more For multitasking requirements
  * USB Headset with Noise-Cancelling Feature
  * Internet Service of 10 Mbps and up (DSL, Fiber, or Cable only)
  * Backup internet service of 10Mbps or more
  * Workstation free from any Noise and Distractions
  * Backup for Power Outage: Generator/UPS or Alternative Location
  * Webcam with Full HD (1080p) video capture
* #### Mac
  * 2 Fully Functioning 64Bit Desktop/Laptop (1 for Backup)
  * macOS Catalina and newer
  * Intel or Silicon(M1+) chip
  * 8 GB RAM or more For multitasking requirements
  * USB Headset with Noise-Cancelling Feature
  * Internet Service of 10Mbps and up (DSL, Fiber, or Cable only)
  * Backup internet service of 10Mbps or more
  * Workstation free from any Noise and Distractions
  * Backup for Power Outage: Generator/UPS or Alternative Location
  * Webcam with Full HD (1080p) video capture

Above mentioned system specifications are REQUIRED for all positions. Backup desktop/laptop, backup
Internet connection, and backup power supply can be provided after passing the interview. Please
ensure to have these systems ready before applying.

[Proceed to Application][3]

## Application Process

Recruitment office hours are from Tuesdays to Saturdays
* ### Step 1
  
  [Step 1]
  
  Submit your application through this web portal.
* ### Step 2
  
  [Step 2]
  
  Initial Interview, Online Test and Systems Check. Please refer to the System Requirements section.
* ### Step 3
  
  [Step 3]
  
  Final interview and release of results.

Play

###### Step-by-Step Application Process

[Apply Now!][4]

## Let’s hear it!

> Before, I was not able to save money because of my daily allowance for work but now I have savings
> for my son. And most importantly, I am with my family every step of the day. As they say, you
> won’t be going back to a call center once you’ve experience home base specially with Virtudesk.

**JAYSON CANLAS,** Inside Sales Associate

> I cannot stress enough on the things I am happy about being with VD and being a GVA. Working in
> the comforts of your own home, spending more time with your family, avoiding the hassle of travel,
> are just a few of the things I enjoy as a GVA with VD.

**JOJO BONQUIN,** General Virtual Assistant

> Working from home does give me the benefit of feeling secure because I don’t have to go to the
> office and leave my loved ones..I am proud to be a member of the Virtudesk family! After all, it
> is our family that we work for.

**CHERISH DALMACIO,** Inside Sales Associate

> When I lost my parents and I was not on their side, it made me realize that it’s the quality time
> and presence with your loved one’s life that matters. And that’s what I found with Virtudesk. I
> get to support my family financially and still be present on their milestones, hardships and
> journey in life. Thank you Virtudesk.

**AISHA MARCO,** ISA / GVA / Transaction Coordinator

> Working with VirtuDesk gave me the flexibility in time that I always wanted, before when I was in
> the BPO industry I was always rushing to work and often stressed out due to the work load and lack
> of sleep. But now I have plenty of time to rest, plenty of time to spend with my love ones and do
> the things that are really worth my time.

**JOHN TOLENTINO,** Inside Sales Associate

> I started my VA career with Virtudesk almost 3 months ago. I haven’t looked back since! Its been
> great so far and the folks here are very nice and accommodating. Would love to grow with a company
> who gives equal opportunities to everyone!

**MICHAEL CARULLA,** Inside Sales Associate

Ocent Monitor's product portfolio includes remote patient monitoring systems, wireless vital sign
monitoring devices, telehealth platforms, chronic disease management solutions, wearable health
monitoring technologies, and healthcare IoT integration systems.

By combining advanced sensor technology, cloud connectivity, and data management capabilities, Ocent
Monitor helps healthcare organizations improve patient engagement, enhance care efficiency, and
support continuous health monitoring beyond traditional clinical settings.

Serving customers across North America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and other international
markets, Shenzhen Ocent Monitor Co., Ltd. provides OEM and ODM services tailored to diverse
healthcare applications and market requirements. Through ongoing investment in research and
development, the company strives to deliver reliable, scalable, and future-oriented remote
healthcare solutions that support the evolving needs of modern healthcare systems worldwide.

* Wireless vital sign monitoring with multi-parameter support

R&D & Innovation

## Continuous Innovation in Connected Healthcare

Ocent Monitor's product portfolio includes remote patient monitoring systems, wireless vital sign
monitoring devices, telehealth platforms, chronic disease management solutions, wearable health
monitoring technologies, and healthcare IoT integration systems.

By combining advanced sensor technology, cloud connectivity, and data management capabilities, Ocent
Monitor helps healthcare organizations improve patient engagement, enhance care efficiency, and
support continuous health monitoring beyond traditional clinical settings.

Serving customers across North America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and other international
markets, Shenzhen Ocent Monitor Co., Ltd. provides OEM and ODM services tailored to diverse
healthcare applications and market requirements. Through ongoing investment in research and
development, the company strives to deliver reliable, scalable, and future-oriented remote
healthcare solutions that support the evolving needs of modern healthcare systems worldwide.
* Advanced sensor technology with clinical-grade accuracy and reliability
* Proprietary cloud connectivity and real-time data management platforms
* Wireless vital sign monitoring with multi-parameter support
* Wearable health technology integrating seamlessly with telehealth ecosystems
* Healthcare IoT integration enabling scalable, interoperable digital health networks
* Continuous R&D investment ensuring future-oriented, evolving product capabilities

**Our platform**

# Healthcare Science Hubs

### Overview

Open MedScience is a structured healthcare science publishing platform organised around thematic
hubs in medical imaging, diagnostics, digital health and wellbeing.

### Expertise

Our thematic hubs provide interdisciplinary analysis across medical imaging, nuclear medicine,
public health and healthcare policy.

### Discovery

OpenMedAI enhances discovery by guiding readers across the hubs and connecting them directly to the
relevant content.

[[Imaging Modalities Hub presents a comprehensive overview of diagnostic imaging technologies]][16]

## **Imaging Modalities Hub**

Explore the Imaging Modalities Hub to gain a structured overview of diagnostic imaging technologies,
including X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and nuclear imaging. This hub explains how these modalities
support diagnosis, monitoring and treatment planning across the clinical practice.

[[Targeted therapy radiopharmaceuticals deliver precision treatment, improve outcomes, minimise
toxicity]][17]

## **Nuclear Therapeutics** **Hub **

The Nuclear Therapeutics Hub examines radiopharmaceutical science and targeted radionuclide
therapies in modern nuclear medicine. This hub evaluates tracer chemistry, radiolabelling,
dosimetry, regulatory science and clinical translation in the area of oncology.

[[Medical imaging improves diagnosis, guides treatment, supports monitoring, enhances
patient-centred clinical decision-making]][18]

## **Clinical Imaging Hub**

The Clinical Imaging Hub bridges diagnostic imaging with everyday clinical practice. Find out how
this hub integrates radiology, nuclear medicine, radiation therapy and medical physics, supporting
training, safety standards and research.

[[Digital Health Hub integrates data, improves care, enables smarter clinical decisions][Digital
Health Hub integrates data, improves care, enables smarter clinical decisions]][19]

## **Digital Health Hub**

The Digital Health Hub explores technologies transforming healthcare delivery and imaging workflows.
This hub covers artificial intelligence, robotics, cybersecurity and digital infrastructure,
emphasising implementation, optimisation and secure data management.

[[Medical Research Hub accelerates discovery, supports collaboration, improves translational
outcomes][Medical Research Hub accelerates discovery, supports collaboration, improves translational
outcomes]][20]

## **Medical Research Hub**

The Medical Research Hub focuses on research quality, governance and clinical translation. Explore
how it connects reproducible methods, regulatory science, and publishing standards to support
responsible innovation and healthcare implementation.

[[Health and medicine advance wellbeing, prevent disease, improve global quality-of-life][Health and
medicine advance wellbeing, prevent disease, improve global quality-of-life]][21]

## **Wellbeing Hub **

The Wellbeing Hub examines medicine, public health and prevention within social and policy contexts.
This hub explores how systems, behaviour and environment influence long-term health outcomes and
community resilience.

[[Explore medical imaging through research, innovation and clinical insight][Explore medical imaging
through research, innovation and clinical insight]][22]

## **Explore**

Open MedScience delivers in-depth coverage of medical imaging, from foundational science to clinical
application. Examine technological progress, artificial intelligence and multidisciplinary practice
shaping modern healthcare.

[[Learn healthcare science through structured insight and expert guidance][Learn healthcare science
through structured insight and expert guidance]][23]

## **Learn **

Advance your professional knowledge through structured insight across healthcare science. Explore
medical physics, radiopharmaceutical science, digital health and translational medicine within a
responsible clinical framework.

[[Contribute a blog article advancing imaging and healthcare science][Contribute a blog article
advancing imaging and healthcare science]][24]

## Contribute

Submit a blog article sharing original research, clinical translation or technology innovation.
Contribute editorial insight, education or health and wellbeing perspectives. Join a collaborative
community advancing imaging and digital health responsibly.

# Healthcare Science Hubs

### Overview

Open MedScience is a structured healthcare science publishing platform organised around thematic
hubs in medical imaging, diagnostics, digital health and wellbeing.

### Expertise

Our thematic hubs provide interdisciplinary analysis across medical imaging, nuclear medicine,
public health and healthcare policy.

### Discovery

OpenMedAI enhances discovery by guiding readers across the hubs and connecting them directly to the
relevant content.

[[Imaging Modalities Hub presents a comprehensive overview of diagnostic imaging technologies]][16]

## **Imaging Modalities Hub**

Explore the Imaging Modalities Hub to gain a structured overview of diagnostic imaging technologies,
including X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and nuclear imaging. This hub explains how these modalities
support diagnosis, monitoring and treatment planning across the clinical practice.

[[Targeted therapy radiopharmaceuticals deliver precision treatment, improve outcomes, minimise
toxicity]][17]

## **Nuclear Therapeutics** **Hub **

The Nuclear Therapeutics Hub examines radiopharmaceutical science and targeted radionuclide
therapies in modern nuclear medicine. This hub evaluates tracer chemistry, radiolabelling,
dosimetry, regulatory science and clinical translation in the area of oncology.

[[Medical imaging improves diagnosis, guides treatment, supports monitoring, enhances
patient-centred clinical decision-making]][18]

## **Clinical Imaging Hub**

The Clinical Imaging Hub bridges diagnostic imaging with everyday clinical practice. Find out how
this hub integrates radiology, nuclear medicine, radiation therapy and medical physics, supporting
training, safety standards and research.

[[Digital Health Hub integrates data, improves care, enables smarter clinical decisions][Digital
Health Hub integrates data, improves care, enables smarter clinical decisions]][19]

## **Digital Health Hub**

The Digital Health Hub explores technologies transforming healthcare delivery and imaging workflows.
This hub covers artificial intelligence, robotics, cybersecurity and digital infrastructure,
emphasising implementation, optimisation and secure data management.

[[Medical Research Hub accelerates discovery, supports collaboration, improves translational
outcomes][Medical Research Hub accelerates discovery, supports collaboration, improves translational
outcomes]][20]

## **Medical Research Hub**

The Medical Research Hub focuses on research quality, governance and clinical translation. Explore
how it connects reproducible methods, regulatory science, and publishing standards to support
responsible innovation and healthcare implementation.

[[Health and medicine advance wellbeing, prevent disease, improve global quality-of-life][Health and
medicine advance wellbeing, prevent disease, improve global quality-of-life]][21]

## **Wellbeing Hub **

The Wellbeing Hub examines medicine, public health and prevention within social and policy contexts.
This hub explores how systems, behaviour and environment influence long-term health outcomes and
community resilience.

[[Explore medical imaging through research, innovation and clinical insight][Explore medical imaging
through research, innovation and clinical insight]][22]

## **Explore**

Open MedScience delivers in-depth coverage of medical imaging, from foundational science to clinical
application. Examine technological progress, artificial intelligence and multidisciplinary practice
shaping modern healthcare.

[[Learn healthcare science through structured insight and expert guidance][Learn healthcare science
through structured insight and expert guidance]][23]

## **Learn **

Advance your professional knowledge through structured insight across healthcare science. Explore
medical physics, radiopharmaceutical science, digital health and translational medicine within a
responsible clinical framework.

[[Contribute a blog article advancing imaging and healthcare science][Contribute a blog article

  Oracle offers the highest-performing cloud services at the lowest cost. That's why so many of the

  Oracle’s Autonomous and AI Database software running on high-performance Exadata hardware is

  Get the same low price everywhere.

  Unifies all your private structured and unstructured data without moving it – by using the AI Data
  Platform's Data Catalog
  
  [Get started with AI Data Catalog][24]

  An end-to-end Integrated Development Environment for building any type of AI Application – chat,
  multistep agents, transactions, workflows – on all your data

  Put the entire Oracle Cloud inside your data center. Cloud@Customer includes every Oracle
  infrastructure service and application. Your data and network traffic stay secure and private
  inside your data center and behind your firewall.
  
  **Enable AI on your Private Data**
  
  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data

[Agentic AI Revenue Engine Dashboard]
80% Reduction in Staff Time on Payer Calls
100% Automated Claim Status Tracking

### Your Revenue Cycle, Running on Autopilot.

OSP's Agentic AI Revenue Engine automates the most repetitive task in your billing workflow —
calling payers to check claim status. It makes the calls, captures the updates, and reports
everything in real time, so your team spends zero time on hold.

#### What It Does:
* Automatically calls payers to check claim status
* Captures claim updates without any manual follow-up
* Logs and reports claim status directly to an Excel sheet
* Replaces hours of staff time spent on hold with payers

[ See It In Action ][113]
[RCM Revenue Engine Dashboard]
4x Faster Denial Resolution with AI
5x Reduction in Denial Management Workload

### Stop Writing Off Denied Claims. Start Recovering Them.

OSP's RCM Revenue Engine pulls denied claims from any source — EHR, clearinghouse, or manual upload
— uses AI to identify the root cause, determines the best course of action, and automates the entire
resolution workflow. From appeal letters to resubmissions to payer follow-up, it handles the work
your team never has time for.

#### What It Does
* Identifies root cause of every denial using AI
* Auto-generates appeal letters tailored to payer requirements
* Resubmits claims or routes complex cases to staff
* Tracks every denial from identification to resolution

[ See It In Action ][114]
[Claims Scrubbing Dashboard]
95%+ First-Pass Clean Claim Rate
50% Reduction in Manual Claim Review

### Every Claim Scrubbed Before It Leaves Your Office.

OSP's AI Claims Scrubbing Agent validates every claim before submission — checking coding accuracy,
payer rules, NCCI edits, and eligibility in real time. It catches the errors, suggests the fixes,
and routes clean claims to the payer, so your billing team never wastes time on preventable denials.

#### What It Does
* Automatically validates CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS codes against payer-specific rules
* Catches coding errors, missing modifiers, and bundling violations before submission
* Verifies patient eligibility, prior auth, and COB in real time
* Routes clean claims to payer and flags dirty claims with specific fix instructions

[ See It In Action ][115]

resolution workflow. From appeal letters to resubmissions to payer follow-up, it handles the work

payer rules, NCCI edits, and eligibility in real time. It catches the errors, suggests the fixes,
and routes clean claims to the payer, so your billing team never wastes time on preventable denials.

* Catches coding errors, missing modifiers, and bundling violations before submission

* Routes clean claims to payer and flags dirty claims with specific fix instructions

* Post author By [abbie_c][12]

## Comprehensive Insights into Otitis Media: Understanding the Condition Thoroughly

### What is Otitis Media? Key Information Everyone Should Know

**Otitis media** refers to an infection or inflammation affecting the **middle ear**, a condition
prevalent in both **children** and **adults**. Recognising and managing this condition is vital, as
it can cause significant discomfort and lead to severe complications if left untreated. The **middle
ear**, located behind the **eardrum**, plays a crucial role in our ability to hear. An infection in
this area can result in fluid accumulation, leading to pain and a feeling of fullness in the ear.
Understanding **[what otitis media is and how to effectively prevent it][15]** is essential for both
**parents** and **healthcare providers**, especially considering its high prevalence in young
children. This age group is particularly vulnerable due to their developing **immune systems** and
shorter **eustachian tubes**.

Otitis media can manifest in various forms, including **acute otitis media**, which is characterised
by a sudden onset and pronounced symptoms, and **otitis media with effusion**, where fluid
accumulates without evident signs of infection. Symptoms can range from mild discomfort to intense
pain and fever, often resulting in temporary hearing loss. Early recognition of these symptoms is
crucial, as it enables timely intervention and treatment, preventing further complications.

### How Can You Identify the Symptoms of Otitis Media?

The symptoms of otitis media can differ considerably between **adults** and **children**. Common
indicators include ear pain, which may vary from a dull ache to sharp, debilitating discomfort.
Young children may find it challenging to articulate their pain, leading to increased irritability
and fussiness. Fever frequently accompanies **ear infections**, as the body’s **[immune
response][16]** kicks in to combat the infection.

Hearing difficulties often arise from the fluid build-up in the middle ear, resulting in temporary
hearing loss. This is particularly concerning for children, as it can adversely affect their
**language development**. Careful monitoring of these symptoms is essential; untreated otitis media
can lead to more serious health issues, such as the spread of infection or chronic hearing
impairment. A thorough understanding of **what otitis media is and how to prevent it** is critical
to mitigate long-term consequences associated with this condition.

### What Are the Causes of Otitis Media? Understanding the Triggers

The primary culprits behind otitis media are **bacterial** or **viral infections**, often triggered
by **colds**, allergies, or sinus infections that cause inflammation in the **eustachian tubes**.
These tubes connect the middle ear to the back of the throat, helping to regulate pressure and
facilitate fluid drainage. When these tubes become swollen or obstructed, fluid can accumulate,
creating an environment conducive to pathogen growth.

Environmental factors significantly influence the incidence of otitis media. Notably, exposure to
**secondhand smoke** poses a considerable risk, particularly for children, as it irritates the
respiratory system and **eustachian tubes**, increasing the likelihood of infections. Allergens such
as **dust mites** and **pet dander** can exacerbate the situation, leading to recurrent infections.
Genetic predisposition also plays a role; children with a family history of ear infections are more
likely to face similar challenges, highlighting the multifaceted nature of this condition.

### How Do Healthcare Professionals Diagnose Otitis Media?

Diagnosing otitis media typically begins with a thorough physical examination conducted by a
qualified healthcare professional. A key diagnostic tool used during this examination is an
**[otoscope][17]**, a handheld device equipped with a light and magnifying lens that enables the
doctor to inspect the ear canal and assess the condition of the **eardrum** for signs of infection,
such as redness, swelling, or fluid accumulation.

In certain cases, additional testing may be necessary to confirm the diagnosis and evaluate the
state of the middle ear. **Tympanometry** is one test that measures the movement of the eardrum and

## Meet the agentic integration company

One platform to integrate AI, data, apps, and services.

### Unify, simplify, amplify

Bring AI, applications and data integration together in a composable, unified, low-code platform
that accelerates automation and AI-led innovation.

### Innovators everywhere

Empower everyone across the enterprise to become an innovator, building and safely deploying
intelligent agents, apps or workflows with AI co-pilot, no-code builders and thousands of
connectors.

### AI with trust and control

Lead your organization into the AI-driven future with an easy-to-use, flexible, secure platform that
unlocks new opportunities at every turn. SnapLogic weaves governance, security, and transparency
into every workflow.

## One agentic integration platform. Four technologies.

One platform, one runtime, one upgrade path. Everything you need to connect, scale, and power your
agentic enterprise.

### Data Integration

#### Seamlessly connect data, everywhere

Break down silos and move data across any system, cloud, or on-premises. With SnapLogic pipelines,
you can integrate, transform, and deliver trusted data at scale. Power your analytics and operations
with data you can rely on.

[Take a Tour][161]

#### The enterprise iPaaS that just works

Automate workflows, connect your apps, and run complex processes fast. Our platform has an intuitive
interface and hundreds of pre-built connectors. You get integration that feels easy, so your team
can focus on results.

[Take a Tour][162]

Publish, manage, and secure your APIs in one place. SnapLogic gives you the controls and analytics
you need, along with seamless integration. Unlock new ways to connect and grow your business.

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

indicators.

#### Insight Development

#### Actionable Deliverables

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

[Read More about Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights][50]
[Trend research illustration showing forecasting and data analysis]

## Thematic and Disruption Research

Our Thematic & Disruption Research identifies the structural shifts, emerging technologies, new
business models, and macro forces reshaping industries. We decode early signals, model long-term
scenarios, and highlight opportunities and risks-equipping leaders with future-ready insight to
guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

Deep dives on cross-cutting themes such as sustainability, digital transformation, AI, automation,
circular economy and new revenue models. We connect these themes back to specific industry and
segment opportunities.

[Read More about Thematic and Disruption Research][51]
[Thematic and Disruption Research]

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

Our Strategic Revenue Advisory helps organizations make confident, evidence-driven decisions about
where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,
customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is
resilient, high-impact, and aligned with long-term growth opportunities.

Support for decisions on where to play, how to win and how fast to move. This includes portfolio
focus, market entry, pricing, partnership strategy and capital allocation grounded in evidence.

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

indicators.

#### Insight Development

#### Actionable Deliverables

#### Follow Through and Measurement

organisations make better revenue decisions.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

Our Medical VAs handle billing, scribing, and reception, freeing your time for patients and personal
life.

#### Work-Life Balance

Our Medical VAs handle routine tasks, letting you leave on time, reduce burnout, and enjoy family
time.

#### Enhanced Productivity

Our Medical VAs streamline workflows, helping your team be efficient, boost patient care, and focus
on what matters.

## Services Provided

We provide comprehensive healthcare virtual assistant services designed to support medical and
dental practices. Our experienced Medical Virtual Assistants handle front-office, clinical, and
administrative tasks—including patient scheduling, communication, medical and dental reception,
scribing, billing, and insurance coordination—so providers can focus on delivering quality care
while maintaining an efficient and organized practice.

Handles patient calls, scheduling, and front-desk communication.

Documents patient visits in real time for providers. Records dental treatment notes accurately
during procedures.

Submits claims and
manages patient / insurance billing.

Secures insurance approvals for medications and procedures.

* Only need one-off or short-term task support
* Prefer managing freelancers directly day-to-day
* Are primarily looking for the lowest-cost labor option
